newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: PRESS DIGEST - Bangladesh Newspapers - July 6.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Bangladesh Newspapers - July 6.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bangladesh press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
A meeting of the Bangladesh -Philippinnes Joint Economic Commission begins in Manila on Monday to boost economic ties between the two countries.
Heavy rains and onrush of waters from hills have flooded vast areas of southeastern Cox's Bazar district.
Some 16 ships were waiting to unload goods and 17 others in outer anchorage as dock workers at the Chittagong Port continued their strike for the third straight day on Saturday.

Opposition Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP) Secretary General Abdul Mannan Bhuiyan on Saturday said his party was ready to cooperate with the government to improve law and order situation if "repression" on BNP workers was stopped.
Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina is due to return home on Sunday ending a six-day official trip to Japan.
The passenger aircraft that nosedived in a mashland off the runway at Chittagong airport Wednesday night was salvaged on Saturday.
About 75 percent of the motor vehicles plying on roads of Dhaka city emit black smoke, environment officials said.
Bangladesh Garments Manufacturers and Exporters Association (BGMEA) has demanded deployment of an "emergency force" for quick solution of disputes at Chittagong Port. REUTER
